query: SELECT count(*) FROM graphify_files gf JOIN graphify_runs gr_first ON gr_first.run_id = gf.first_seen_run_id JOIN graphify_runs gr_last ON gr_last.run_id = gf.last_seen_run_id WHERE gr_first.status = 'COMPLETED' AND gr_last.status != 'COMPLETED'
interpretation: Zero graphify_files rows have a COMPLETED first_seen_run_id whose last_seen_run_id was later overwritten by a non-COMPLETED (RUNNING) run. A status='COMPLETED' filter on the legacy bridge join does not hide any currently-eroded completed evidence for today's population.
